Detail-oriented with a strong sense of ownership
Proactive mindset with a can-do attitude
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
Eagerness to learn and grow within a professional environment.

benefits.label: Training budget and certification sponsorship
Recognition programs and quarterly awards
Holiday and Tet bonus
Laptop and equipment provided
Premium healthcare package for employee and dependents
